fields.value: Let a Curve score each checkpoint against whichever earlier checkpoint of its line it met

## Problem

A progress chart pairs each checkpoint with an earlier checkpoint of its own line chosen by the experiment (manabot's TLA frontier: the latest checkpoint at or before half the elapsed training hours, so not an exact `Fraction` of updates). With `opponent=None`, a checkpoint's point averages every match it sat in, including the ones where it was the *earlier* partner of a later checkpoint, so the point mixes both roles. `Earlier`/`Fraction`/`At` need an exact position and leave gaps here. An operator script (`.runs/c5fba4-operator/live_report.py`, manabot.c5fba4-frontier-self-play checkout) worked around this by keeping only cells whose opponent is an earlier checkpoint of the same run.

## Outcome

A `Curve` opponent kind (for example `Before(clock="updates")`) meaning: each point is scored only against checkpoints of its own line that stood earlier on `clock`, whichever it met, so above 0.5 means the model improved since then. The page computes it with `compare` (interval over those matches), not in the browser.

Consumer: `manabot.training.report.against_earlier_self` (MTG-274) would pass it.
